scope: one typed local create-entity Scene command
verifiedBehavior: requires a non-duplicate stable dbx: entity ID
requires an existing semantic kind, semantic name, valid color, and editable ownership
requires explicit grid alignment and snaps x/y to the declared Scene grid
rejects stale bases and invalid or out-of-bounds geometry through the established command spine
preserves existing entities and supports existing undo/redo history
excluded: Walls, native doors, Regions, Background Objects, Tiles, lights, notes, relationships
image transforms, vision predictions, Spatial Blueprint promotion
project persistence, Foundry mutation, provider or credential action
